dedupe_keys.name: north east nigeria adamawa state herams health resources availability and 5w e atlas june 2018 hdx

description: This dataset maps health facilities and health partners in Adamawa State, north east Nigeria, as of June 2018, from the Health Resources and Services Availability Monitoring System (HeRAMS) and the health sector's who-does-what-where-when-for-whom (5W) mapping. It was prepared by iMMAP with the World Health Organization and the health sector coordination in the crisis-affected north east. Coverage is Adamawa State. The data are free to download as a shapefile from the Humanitarian Data Exchange under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: the snapshot dates from 2018 and has not been updated, facility functionality and services changed quickly during the conflict, and attribute definitions follow the HeRAMS questionnaire of that time. Simulation uses: building a conflict-affected health facility network for access and service disruption analyses, testing how facility closures shift demand, and comparing later HeRAMS rounds. Related records: HeRAMS (data-herams-health-resources-and-services-availability-monitoring-system-p02620) is the WHO monitoring system behind the data, and the Nigeria health facility registry extract (data-nigeria-health-facility-registry-extract) covers the whole country.
